from manim import *

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#050510"

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Background atmospheric gradient
        bg_circle = Circle(radius=8, fill_color=["#0a0a1a", "#1a1a2e"], fill_opacity=0.8)
        bg_circle.set_z_index(-10)
        self.add(bg_circle)
        
        # Light source effect behind equation
        aura = Circle(radius=3.5, fill_color=YELLOW_E, fill_opacity=0.15)
        aura.set_z_index(-5)
        aura.shift(UP*0.2)
        
        # Construct equation with separated components for coloring
        equation = MathTex("E", "=", "m", "c^2", font_size=120)
        equation[0].set_color(YELLOW_E)  # Energy
        equation[1].set_color(WHITE)     # Equals
        equation[2].set_color(BLUE_C)    # Mass
        equation[3].set_color(RED_C)     # Speed of light
        
        # Create glow layers
        glows = VGroup()
        for i in range(4):
            glow = equation.copy()
            glow.set_stroke(YELLOW, opacity=0.3/(i+1), width=4-i)
            glow.set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0)
            glow.scale(1.05 + i*0.03)
            glow.shift(UP*0.02*i)
            glows.add(glow)
        
        equation_group = VGroup(glows, equation, aura)
        equation_group.center()
        
        # Typography hierarchy
        title = Text("SPECIAL RELATIVITY", font="Arial", weight=BOLD, font_size=48)
        title.set_color(WHITE)
        title.set_stroke(WHITE, opacity=0.3, width=0.5)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=1.2)
        
        subtitle = Text("Mass-Energy Equivalence", font="Arial", slant=ITALIC, font_size=32)
        subtitle.set_color(GRAY_B)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        # Initial camera state - intimate close-up
        self.camera.frame.set_height(equation_group.get_height() * 1.8)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(equation_group.get_center())
        
        # Animation sequence
        # 1. Ambient aura fades in
        self.play(FadeIn(aura, scale=1.5, run_time=2))
        
        # 2. Staggered glow emergence
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                *[FadeIn(g, scale=1.2, run_time=1.8) for g in glows],
                lag_ratio=0.15
            ),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # 3. Main equation writes in with precision
        self.play(
            Write(equation, run_time=2.5),
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # 4. Cinematic pull-back revealing title
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.set_height(12).move_to(ORIGIN),
            FadeIn(title, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1.5),
            FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5),
            run_time=3.5,
            rate_func=ease_out_expo
        )
        
        # 5. Subtle floating camera movement (breathing)
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.shift(UP*0.3 + RIGHT*0.2).rotate(0.008),
            run_time=4,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # 6. Glow pulse - energy radiating
        self.play(
            *[glow.animate.scale(1.08).set_stroke(opacity=0.6) for glow in glows],
            aura.animate.scale(1.1).set_opacity(0.25),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=there_and_back
        )
        
        # 7. Gentle drift hold
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.shift(DOWN*0.4 + LEFT*0.3),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        
        # 8. Final subtle pulse
        self.play(
            *[glow.animate.scale(1.05) for glow in glows],
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=there_and_back
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
